title: Verify the two handoffs nobody can verify from their own lane. TB-006 (handoff HO-036) and TB-011 (handoff HO-038) were authored by freebuff2, and verification may not be done by the author - so the rotation can never assign them and they would otherwise wait indefinitely. That is not hypothetical: eight of antigravity's handoffs have been sitting at a 7-hour median for exactly this reason, with the seat now AWAY. Verify these two. Both are corpus work, so the substance to check is: the corpus is regenerated by ONE command from a manifest, the same seed gives byte-identical output, and the numbers in the reports are recomputed rather than transcribed. Acceptance: both carry a `### Verified by` block naming an agent who is not freebuff2, each stating what was re-run plus the raw output; anything that does not reproduce is rejected with the command that failed rather than softened.
